blocks: The Union Public Service Commission ( UPSC ) announced the final results for the Civil Services Examination (CSE) 2025 on March 6, 2026. Among the 958 recommended candidates, Zinnia Aurora has achieved an outstanding feat by securing All India Rank (AIR) 6. Her journey from being an IPS officer to securing a top-10 rank is a powerful example of dedication and the drive for continuous self-improvement.

Zinnia Aurora hails from Rohtak, Haryana, and currently resides in New Delhi. Born in 2001, she comes from a family with a strong foundation in administration and governance. Her father, Rajeev Kumar Arora, is retired, while her mother, Anjana Arora, served as a Deputy Excise and Taxation Commissioner. Growing up in a disciplined environment influenced by public service, Zinnia was naturally inclined toward the civil services from an early age.

Zinnia Aurora has maintained a stellar academic record throughout her life. She completed her schooling at Sanskriti School, New Delhi, where she was a batch topper. For her higher education, she attended the prestigious St. Stephen's College, University of Delhi, focusing on subjects like Environmental Science and Economics.

Beyond academics, Zinnia is the Co-founder of PeaceX, a non-profit organization dedicated to international policy and youth empowerment. She has collaborated with global institutions, including the United Nations, on initiatives related to sustainability and the circular economy. This deep involvement in policy and international relations significantly enriched her preparation for the UPSC.

Zinnia chose Political Science and International Relations (PSIR) as her optional subject. This choice was highly strategic, as it aligned perfectly with her academic interests and her professional work in international policy. Her success highlights the advantage of choosing an optional subject that complements one's background and practical experience.

As per the marks released by the Union Public Service Commission, Zinnia Aurora secured All India Rank (AIR) 6 in the UPSC Civil Services Examination 2025. The candidate scored 822 marks in the written (Mains) examination and 215 marks in the Personality Test (Interview), achieving a final total of 1037 marks. This outstanding performance helped Zinnia Aurora secure a place among the top rank holders in the UPSC CSE 2025.

Zinnia Aurora’s success is attributed to her ability to analyze her previous performances and identify weak areas. Even after securing a rank in the 150s, she did not settle, proving that with a refined strategy and consistent effort, one can bridge the gap to the top ranks. Her focus on answer-writing and deep conceptual clarity in PSIR was pivotal in her leap to the top 10.
